settings.title: Tuned to stay tuned
settings.text: Thousands of hammer strikes, finished in soundproofed tuning chambers. Documented cases of instruments holding their voice for over six years — and when one does need attention, the workshop retunes it.

settings.text: The signature alloy — stability of nitrided, voice of stainless. 0.9 mm, even across the shell.

settings.text: The traditional deep-drawing steel — warm, familiar, endlessly workable.
